US8069128B2.description: A patent document titled "Real-time ad-hoc spam filtering of email" describing a multi-pass ad-hoc spam message filtering approach.

Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering.description: A filtering approach that dynamically generates a temporary classifier during a first pass based on results of a previously applied message filter that sorts messages into folders, then uses the classifier in a second pass to retrospectively inspect messages.

Classification Model.description: A model generated during the first pass analysis based on message folder placement and message attributes, used to score and identify misclassified messages; it resides exclusively in non-persistent memory and is purged after use.

First Message Filter.description: A previously applied message filter that sorts messages into a plurality of different message folders and stores first classification data in a persistent store.

Second Multi-Pass Message Filter.description: A filter configured to generate a classification model based on a first pass analysis, perform a second pass on sorted messages to identify misclassifications, and purge the model from non-persistent memory.

Network Device.description: A device comprising a transceiver to send and receive data over a network and a processor operative to perform first and second pass analyses, display misclassification identifications, and purge the classification model from non-persistent memory.

Transceiver.description: A component of the network device that sends and receives data over a network.

Processor.description: A component of the network device operative to perform actions including first pass analysis, second pass analysis, displaying misclassification identifications, and purging the classification model.

Message Folders.description: A plurality of different folders into which messages are sorted by the first message filter, used as a basis for training and generating the classification model.

Misclassification Identification.description: A generated identification of sorted messages that might be misclassified, displayed so that at least one misclassified message can be moved to a different message folder.

Non-Persistent Memory Location.description: A memory-resident-only location where the generated classification model resides exclusively, not stored on disk or in another persistent data store, and from which the model is purged.

Persistent Store.description: A data store where the first message filter stores first classification data.

Processor Readable Storage Medium.description: A medium including data and instructions whose execution on a computing device provides for managing messages.

Client Device.description: A user's device on which the classification model is maintained in memory and on which the first and second passes of the multi-pass message filter may occur entirely.

Address Book.description: A book associated with a recipient that is associated with the message folders, used in analysis to determine whether a message sender's address is present.

Message Header.description: A header of a message, including a subject and originating network address, read during the first pass analysis.

Message Content.description: The contents of a message read during the first pass analysis and used in generating the classification model.

Message Attachments.description: Attachments of messages read during the first pass analysis.

Sender Information.description: Information about the sender of a message, read during the first pass analysis.

Message Score.description: A score assigned to each message during the second pass using the second classification data, used to identify messages sorted into an incorrect message folder.
